ordering_proof: this file is committed to git before any tranche-99 episode, study row or LLM decision exists anywhere in this repo or the factory; the commit history is the timestamp
question: Does the shipped Ammonix v0.6 runtime (kernel decision field: the Ether read directly as neighbour-count success over the stored label-space Knowledge Universe; Lambda places, the Ether decides) beat a fair (parity-fixed) LLM agent loop on fresh episodes untouched by any Ammonix development? Same design as comparison_v4_tranche98 with exactly one change: the decision field.

world.factory_root: ..\Ammonix_Generic\Cardessa_Admin_factory at main aee54ab (v0.6 activated, APPROVALS.md 2026-08-14) - READ ONLY for this evaluation
world.world_version: v0.4 world unchanged (CO-18 duplicate-claim mechanic); v0.6 runtime = v0.5 + kernel decision field as shipped default
world.allocation_provenance: identical to the factory's scripts/policy_rollout.py and this repo's tranche-92 comparison (run_comparison.py ALLOCATION)
world.generation_path: cardessa.expansion.expansion_studies(world_ext, MASTER_SEED, 99, allocation, 5000) after cardessa.livecases.training_world replay of v4-build's recorded expansion.json (tranches 1-8); episodes played by CardessaEnvironment under the v0.6 code (identical world/engine code; only route_case's decision field differs); no sealed or quarantined data touched
world.why_tranche_99: 90, 92, 96, 97 spent by v0.4 analyses; 98 spent by the v0.4 pre-registered comparison and its two disclosed post-hoc arms; 99 is the first draw no arm and no development step has ever seen. The kernel-Ether experiments used tranche 92 (already spent) only.

arms.personas: scripted human persona baseline (also the bit-exact identity canary replayed by run_v4_arm.py)
arms.agentic: this repo's LLM agent loop on the pinned local model, with the v0.4 briefing-parity fixes (CO-18 legend + duplicate rule, persona_id, subscriber_relationship rendered) (unchanged from v0.4)
arms.ammonix_v6: BasisRuntime.load with the shipped v0.6 default (decision_field=kernel; AMMONIX_DECISION_FIELD unset): route_case with neighbour-count episode-success scores (K=200, min support 3, Laplace 2, corpus-rate fallback), forced CO-16 honoured, confidence floor 0.05, EV close-out, case-based fallback; zero LLM calls at decision time; escalations fall back to the persona policy (as in every arm)
arms.oracle_greedy: evaluation-only upper bound as in v0.4 (engine truth per touch); not a competitor

model_pin.note: 1 initial attempt + 1 applicability-feedback retry; second violation or explicit escalate hands the touch to the persona

metrics.primary: success_rate_v2 (outcome v2: >=90% of allowed collected within 120 days, per cardessa.corpus SUCCESS_FRACTION=0.9)
secondary: payer_collected_capped, formula version v2-cap-total-4: sum over episodes of min(collected_payer, allowed) - identical to the tranche-92 comparison.json summaries
mean_score: outcome-v2 score minus 0.10 per process mistake (MISTAKE_PENALTY)
episodes_with_mistakes: factory cardessa.corpus.compute_mistakes, v0.4 ledger including mistake_resubmitted_paid_claim
LLM cost per arm (calls, tokens) - reported, not a win condition

noise_model.framing: single-draw noise, same framing as the tranche-92 dashboard (which called a 1-pt success gap within noise)
noise_model.statement: one draw of 300 episodes: a success-rate difference within +/-5.6 percentage points (95% binomial CI half-width at p~0.46, n=300) is inside single-draw noise; the dashboard's informal ~4 pts corresponded to ~1.4 SE, the pre-registered tie band uses the full 5.6-pt 95% half-width

hypothesis: With the briefing handicaps removed, the agentic arm improves over its tranche-92 showing (0.4567 success), but the shipped Ammonix v0.6 runtime still matches or beats it on success rate and collects more capped dollars with fewer mistake episodes, at zero decision-time LLM cost.

decision_rule.ammonix_wins: success_rate_v2(ammonix_v6) - success_rate_v2(agentic) > +0.0564, OR the success gap is within the tie band AND ammonix_v6 leads payer_collected_capped by more than 5% with episodes_with_mistakes <= agentic's
decision_rule.tie: success gap within +/-0.0564 and neither capped-dollars condition met in either direction
decision_rule.ammonix_loses: success_rate_v2(agentic) - success_rate_v2(ammonix_v6) > +0.0564, OR the success gap is within the tie band AND agentic leads payer_collected_capped by more than 5% with episodes_with_mistakes <= ammonix_v6's
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_metric_switching: the verdict is read off this rule only; all other numbers are descriptive

procedure: 1. (this commit) pre-registration, before any tranche-99 data exists
2. smoke test: first 5 episodes of tranche 99, all three arms end-to-end, canary verified - not interpreted beyond mechanics

3. full run after review: run_comparison.py --arms personas,agentic --tranche 99 --report comparison_v6_tranche99.json --tag _v6t99 (AMMONIX_FACTORY_ROOT=v6-build), then run_v6_arm.py --report comparison_v6_tranche99.json --tag _v6t99
4. one run, no reruns, no episode exclusions; the decision cache freezes the agentic arm

amendments.what: the v0.4 pre-registration text said '>=98%' while cardessa.corpus.SUCCESS_FRACTION has been 0.9 throughout and the paper reports >=90%; this v6 pre-registration states the code's actual definition. Not a change to any threshold; a correction of copied text.

companion_analyses_pre_specified.ablation: ammonix_v6 with universe/memory gates disabled (as ablation_v4_tranche98 arm_definition), same tranche-99 episodes, reported descriptively
companion_analyses_pre_specified.learning_curve: kernel decision field trained on 50/100/250/500/1000/all remembered claims, three draws, scored on the fixed 200-claim demonstration scoreboard (not tranche 99)
companion_analyses_pre_specified.imitation_bc: behavior-cloning baseline as in comparison_posthoc_v4t98, replayed on tranche 99, reported as post-hoc
companion_analyses_pre_specified.note: listed here so nothing about them is post-hoc except the label; verdict is read off decision_rule only

source_design: preregistration/comparison_v4_tranche98.json (design copied verbatim; only the decision field, tranche, and dates changed)
